purpose: Interface smoke for the generate path: one TP03 tray scene and one TP04 platter scene in the near bucket. Reported separately; not counted in stage 0 reliability.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first instance of each template; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.engineering: fixed K_v1 tool chain (TP01: locate,grasp; TP03/TP04: locate,grasp,place)

prediction: Both instances generate and qualify (or a rejection is recorded with its reason); ready scenes load; both negatives and engineering episodes finish with result, verdict, tools, boundary_states and integration_states; tasks.json rows carry bucket=near.
falsification: A generated scene fails to load, a target lands outside the near bucket, or any episode ends with a system execution failure.
